_comment: Qwen3.5-VL vision tower. `params` field name = the bound name the DSL / weights.json reference; `from` paths index the VERBATIM HF `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` config.json (the configs here carry it byte-for-byte). Rotary tower: `rope_half_dim = head_dim / 2`. Reproduces the old `VisionFamily::Qwen3_5Vl` derivation (keys hidden_size/depth/num_heads/in_channels; temporal/merge default to 1 only when absent — both present here). ORDER MATTERS: `expr` entries read bounds that earlier entries defined. Qwen3.5 vision blocks hardcode 1e-6 in the modeling code (transformers / mlx-vlm); the old spec carried `norm_eps_key: None` -> 1e-6 default, which the parse default already supplies, so no `vision_norm_eps` is declared. The learned pos-embed table is interpolated host-side per forward (`fast_pos_embed_interpolate`, bilinear default — so no `vision_pos_emb_interp`). MLX-converted checkpoints ship the 5D conv weight channels-LAST; `try_load_mm` sniffs the actual layout at load, so `channels_last` only marks "may need the permute".
